description: Decide whether to open, avoid or manage a XRP 4H trade. Returns LONG, SHORT or NEUTRAL/NO TRADE, Entry, liquidity-zone SL and TP, setup strength and market diagnostics. Costs 0.03 USDC on Base per paid request; requires an x402-capable wallet and user spending authorization. If SL or TP is null, do not open a new position. On the first call the tool returns x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with _meta['x402/payment']. A successful response includes _meta['x402/payment-response'].
name: get_xrp_4h_setup
title: Buy and get XRP 4H setup
